name: OPERAnet
summary: Synchronized complex WiFi CSI, UWB, passive WiFi radar, and Kinect dataset for activity recognition and localization.

hardware.platform: Three Intel NUC devices plus RF and vision sensors

settings.scenario: Daily activities and natural movement in two rooms

standardization.notes: Preserve complex CSI, all 30 subcarriers, and the documented 3 Tx × 3 Rx layout. Infer each excerpt's effective rate from its full millisecond timestamp span (nominal 1600 Hz), then create complete 100 Hz task windows without dropping the remainder.
